entities.summary: Joseph Lual-Acuil Jr. is a South Sudanese-Australian professional basketball player for Al Ahly Ly of the Libyan Basketball League and Basketball Africa League (BAL). He is also contracted with the Perth Wildcats of the National Basketball League (NBL). He played college basketball for Neosho County Community College and Baylor University. In 2021, he won an NBL championship with Melbourne United. In 2024, he won MVP of the Basketball Africa League with Al Ahly Ly.
